name: kllm-bench-corpus
description: A collected corpus intended to support evaluation of (Korean-focused) language models across multiple NLP tasks and prompts. It aggregates diverse task instances (e.g., QA, generation, classification) to form a benchmarking resource for model evaluation and fine-tuning comparisons.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (accuracy for classification/MCQ, exact_match/F1 for QA, BLEU/ROUGE for generation) — commonly reported as accuracy or composite task scores
general_score_metric: task-dependent (commonly accuracy or composite_score aggregated across tasks)
reputation: A community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face aimed at benchmarking LLMs for Korean and multilingual use; modest adoption within niche communities.
